pageDescription: Each category defines the spec fields its products are filtered and compared by.
emptyDescription: A product needs a category, and a category's specs are what make the storefront filterable. Start here.
deleteDescription.one: "{name}" and its {count} spec field are removed. Categories that still have products cannot be deleted.
deleteDescription.other: "{name}" and its {count} spec fields are removed. Categories that still have products cannot be deleted.
sheetDescription: The specs defined here become the filters and comparison rows for every product in this category.
translateFilled.one: Filled {count} language. Save to keep it.
translateFilled.other: Filled {count} languages. Save to keep them.
slugHint: The URL segment on the storefront.
descriptionPlaceholder: Shown at the top of the category page.
codeHint: Internal identifier. Stable — products reference it.
specsHint: Order matters — it is the order they appear in on the storefront.
specKeyHint: Used in filter URLs and in the product API. Changing it orphans existing values.
specHelpPlaceholder: Shown under the filter on the storefront.
toggleFilterHint: Shows as a filter in the category listing.
toggleComparableHint: Appears as a row in the product comparison table.
toggleRequiredHint: A product in this category cannot be published without it.
specEmpty: No spec fields yet. They are what make this category filterable and comparable.
